prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1271; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection, reporting neck pain with stiffness and limited rotation to the left. Examination findings were consistent with cervical strain, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced range of motion, and imaging confirmed the soft tissue injury. The mechanism of the collision aligns well with the type of injury described. Conservative management included manual therapy, guided home exercise, and anti-inflammatory medication, delivered over fifteen visits. Recovery was somewhat slower than typical for this presentation, though steady gains were documented at each follow-up. The patient reports a remote, minor strain to the same region years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no duplicate or repeated charges. At last assessment the patient had improved substantially, with residual mild stiffness and good functional tolerance for daily activities.
